Proposed question: Complete these equivalent fractions.
a) $\displaystyle 5=\frac{\boxed{\rule{0pt}{4mm}\hspace{11mm}}}{8}$
b) $\displaystyle 12=\frac{\boxed{\rule{0pt}{4mm}\hspace{11mm}}}{3}$
c) $\displaystyle 4=\frac{28}{\boxed{\rule{0pt}{4mm}\hspace{8mm}}}$
d) $\displaystyle 10=\frac{90}{\boxed{\rule{0pt}{4mm}\hspace{8mm}}}$
Answers: a) $40$; b) $36$; c) $7$; d) $9$
